main_text.l: ditesco, ζῶ vivo, ὑγιαίνω valeo, absoluta
Communia, ut ἐργάζομαι τὴν γῆν, colo terra: ἡ γῆ
ἐργάζεταί με, & terra colitur à me. Demosthenes, ὡς
non ulcifcimur. Idem, ὀρθῶς ἐγὼ λογίζομαι
παραλογίζεται ἡ διάνοια αὐτῶν, decipitur mens ab

page.notes: Greek passages are partly faint and were transcribed with uncertainty; the accents and some letters may not match the printed forms exactly. The word "Cap." at lower right is a catchword. Small marks in the left margin near line 'do passiué' are not legible text.
